source: Immutable V13 scores/cohorts/maps/references and V14 point-only evidence alignment
analyses: All 16 V13 strict/proxy x baseline/expanded-coded risk x 3h/6h x hadm/raw settings, with no outcome-driven selection
seed_rule: Sort unique (window_hours,ecg_variant,response_definition) groups. Development seed=base+1000*group_index; frozen test seed=development+1; paired common-person seed=development+2. Identical subject-order resamples across risk variants
resampling_unit: Patient; exactly one selected earliest ED stay per subject; ordinary multinomial patient weights, no outcome stratification
development_bootstrap: Refit immutable V9 reference routines using development response only; report both default-eight-bin and short-semantic-tail-guarded policies, all failures, abstentions and duplicate representatives
test_bootstrap: Frozen V13 development probability maps and frozen references; do not refit thresholds or probabilities on test resamples
paired_bootstrap: Common complete test subjects of each new ECG candidate and old logic_patch, same fixed risk variant; paired AUROC/AUPRC differences on identical patient resamples
intervals: Pointwise 2.5th and 97.5th percentile over finite replicates; 200 draws have coarse endpoints; no multiplicity-adjusted or clinical-superiority claim
reported_main_response: raw ADMITTED/HOME; hospitalization linkage is a separate analysis
